business.text: We are a leading vertically integrated Electronics Manufacturing Services (“EMS”) company providing OEM and ODM solutions across fast- moving electrical goods, including fans, kitchen appliances, home comfort appliances, and electrical components, to leading national and international consumer appliance brands in India (“Consumer Appliance Brands”). In addition to our EMS operations, we have established a consumer-facing presence through our wholly owned subsidiary, Lazer India Private Limited (“Lazer”), which markets a range of consumer electrical and domestic appliances under the “Lazer” brand.

emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Vardhman Appliances Limited
emails.text:
Dear Himanshu Shekhar Jha and Sri,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Vardhman Appliances Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 30, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON VARDHMAN APPLIANCES
Vardhman Appliances is a leading vertically integrated Electronics Manufacturing Services company providing OEM and ODM solutions across fast- moving electrical goods. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)       869.62     835.93     758.54
Growth (YoY)                           4.0%      10.2%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                         51.96      44.84      46.29
EBITDA margin                          6.0%       5.4%       6.1%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)               22.48      18.52      21.82
PAT margin                             2.6%       2.2%       2.9%
Net worth (₹ cr)                     100.47      77.46      45.27
Return on net worth                   22.4%      23.9%      48.2%
Debt / Equity                         1.22x      1.28x      1.77x
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Vardhman Appliances (Parmod Kumar Jain, Subodh Kumar Jain and Vinod Kumar Jain) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
